# Copilot Instructions

- Follow conventions established by the repository and its existing documentation.
- Before changing code, inspect the relevant implementation and nearby tests.
- Keep changes focused; avoid unrelated refactors and preserve existing public interfaces unless the task requires otherwise.
- Add or update focused tests for behavior changes, and run the narrowest relevant validation available.
- If project-specific instructions or tooling are added, prefer those over assumptions in these general guidelines.
